messages:
tess: Heads up, hitting a weird duplication + 429 pattern in the C# onboarding sample when prefetch=4 and maxConcurrency=8. Looks like HttpClient is replaying an old HttpRequestMessage after auth refresh and that request contains a stale cursor stream.

owen: can you paste logs or minimal repro? is this only the C# sampleapp?

tess: only seen in the C# sample so far. Logs show sequence:

```
DBG FetchPage cursor=curA -> 50 items
DBG Response 401 -> starting token refresh
DBG Token refreshed
DBG Retry sending HttpRequestMessage (cursor=curA) -> 429
DBG FetchPage cursor=curB -> 50 items
DBG FetchPage cursor=curA -> 50 items  // duplicate page
```

rachel: that matches "replayed request body" behavior. In .NET HttpRequestMessage.Content can be a stream that, if not cloned, gets re-sent with the same position. If the paginator advanced the cursor concurrently, the retried request still contains old cursor.

oten: short-term mitigation: set prefetch=1 or ensure each request uses a fresh StringContent/MemoryStream copy before dispatch. But that's painful for customers.

own: SDK-level fix idea: add a retry-time hook taking a RequestSnapshot (method, url, bodyHash, streamId, cursor) and current PaginatorState; default retry policy calls replay if idempotent. For paginated fetches return false when snapshot.cursor != state.LatestCursor(streamId). Also emit metric "paginator.retry_dropped" with tags {sdk:cs, tenant:tenant}.

tess: sample of sketchy repro (C#):

```csharp
var req = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, url) {
  Content = new StringContent($"{\"cursor\": \"{cursor}\"}", Encoding.UTF8, "application/json")
};
await httpClient.SendAsync(req); // if retried, same req.Content reused
```

rachel: yup. We should also add a defensive check in the HTTP retry handler: if request has a recognized paginator cursor field, call ShouldReplay and if false, drop the replay and increment telemetry. Safer than forcing customers to change apps.

own: agree. For parity, mirror the same API we added in Python (RetryGuard/should_replay) and expose it in JS/Go/CS too. Make it opt-out for older SDKs.

tess: I'll open a PR with the retry hook + metric + docs note for the C# sample recommending prefetch <= concurrency until we ship. Will include a tiny repro harness.

ci-bot: Created issue #4872: "cs-sdk: paginator replay after auth refresh leads to duplicate pages when prefetch > concurrency"

release-bot: Staging preview for tess/cs-prefetch-fix available at https://staging.internal.redwood/sampleapp/cs/tess-prefetch-fix

tess: thanks. adding e2e suggestion to issue: simulate 401 for first N prefetch requests while advancing cursor to ensure no duplicates. Also include changelog entry if we change default replay semantics (minor version).

own: will review PR tomorrow. good catch and good parity note for other SDKs.

rachel: pushing for telemetry+opt-in flag in the 1st patch so we can roll forward quickly and then tighten guard in a follow-up release.

tess: sounds good, PR incoming.
